entries.name: EXTEND_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The client ID of an API Integration made for KaratOS in the Extend Merchant Portal. With the secret it is traded for a short-lived access token. It goes only to Extend.
howToGet: A store admin (or a user with the integrator role) signs in to the Extend Merchant Portal, opens the Integration tab and clicks New API Integration.
Name it KaratOS and, if you like, give it an expiration date; put a reminder in to make a new one before then.
Extend has no read-only option for these credentials, which can do anything the store's API can. KaratOS only reads with them, but keep them as carefully as a password.
Copy the client ID straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: EXTEND_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The client secret of the same Extend API Integration. It goes only to Extend's token endpoint and is never logged.
howToGet: The Merchant Portal shows the secret next to the client ID when the API Integration is made. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: EXTEND_STORE_ID
entries.description: The store's ID in Extend, a UUID. Contracts are searched by it as the seller, and orders as the store.
howToGet: Copy the Store ID from the Extend Merchant Portal.

entries.name: EXTEND_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Optional. production for the store's Extend account, or demo for Extend's demo environment, which needs its own API Integration from the demo Merchant Portal. Defaults to production.
howToGet: Leave it unset for the store's own Extend account.
